Trump isn't an ideologue. He’s transactional, desperate for a legacy after the midterms, and capable of either starting a nuclear war OR abolishing nuclear weapons. 

Putin and Xi won’t gang up on him. They’ll flatter him. That’s how you play to Trump.

Meanwhile, the nuclear picture is deteriorating. Israel is reportedly expanding its warhead program by 90 warheads with massive underground construction. Every nuclear power is modernizing.

And yet: 87% of Americans aged 18-29 oppose the Iran war. Never reached during Vietnam. Never reached during Iraq.

Kuznick’s ask for Shenzhen: finish what Reagan and Gorbachev almost accomplished 40 years ago. The world would love it.

And what better legacy could a president ask for?
